usage.pipeline: News → Opportunity/Threat → Related Product → Current Capability → Gap → Product Action
usage.mapping_rule: News may map to any active_for_news_mapping product when evidence supports the relationship.
usage.gap_baseline_rule: Only products with allowed_gap_baseline=true may be treated as confirmed current VSF capability baselines without additional human validation.
usage.ecosystem_rule: Capabilities of Vingroup ecosystem products or enabling technologies must not be inherited by Core VSF products automatically.
usage.historical_rule: Historical references provide context only and must not be treated as current products or capabilities.
usage.unknown_rule: Do not convert known_unknowns into confirmed facts. Output TO_VERIFY when a decision depends on them.

portfolio_role_definitions.CORE_VSF_PRODUCT: Direct VSF product and valid baseline for product gap analysis.
portfolio_role_definitions.CORE_VSF_MODULE: Direct VSF module and valid baseline for product gap analysis.
portfolio_role_definitions.VINGROUP_ECOSYSTEM_PRODUCT: Relevant product in the broader Vingroup ecosystem; map news where relevant but validate ownership and integration before using as VSF baseline.
portfolio_role_definitions.VINGROUP_ENABLING_TECHNOLOGY: Technology that may enable or supply a VSF product; do not treat as an end-user VSF product or automatically transfer capabilities.
portfolio_role_definitions.LEGACY_ECOSYSTEM_PRODUCT: Legacy product whose current commercial status and integration require validation.
portfolio_role_definitions.HISTORICAL_REFERENCE: Historical umbrella portfolio used only for context.
